guidecheckbox_147990.name: checkbox-certify
guidecheckbox_147990.options: [1=I certify that before I drive on University business\, I: ]

guidetextdraw_769383._value:
a. Will/have complete(d) all required training for the vehicle(s) I drive on University business.

b. Will/have a current STD 261 on file, if driving my personal vehicle.

c. Will/have complete(d) INF 1101 and am enrolled in the California Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Employer Pull Notice (EPN) program.

d. Will inform my supervisor immediately in the event my driver’s license expires, is suspended or is revoked.

e. Will report immediately to my supervisor all on-the-job vehicle accidents whenever I am the driver, on forms designated by the California State University Fullerton.

f. Have not been issued more than three moving violations or have been responsible for more than three accidents (or any combination of more than three violations/accidents) during the past twelve-month period.

g. Will not drive on University business if at any time I have been issued more than three moving violations or have been responsible for more than three accidents (or any combination of more than three violations/accidents) in any twelve-month period.
guidetextdraw_769383.name: text_drivercertification

guidetextbox_284705481.jcr:title: a. if I am driving a University vehicle either outside the course and scope of my job duties or while I am not authorized to drive on University business, I am liable for any losses resulting from that activity. b. my auto liability insurance will be the primary coverage in the event of an accident while driving on University business in my personal vehicle(s). c. if I incorrectly or falsely certify, I may be disciplined up to and including non-retention in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement and/or CSU/University policy and/or no longer be authorized to drive on University business.
guidetextbox_284705481._value:
a. I am in possession of a valid California or other state’s driver’s license.

b. If I am driving a University vehicle either outside the course and scope of my job duties or while I am not authorized to drive on University business, I am liable for any losses resulting from that activity.

c. My auto liability insurance will be the primary coverage in the event of an accident while driving on University business in my personal vehicle(s).

d. If I incorrectly or falsely certify, I may be disciplined up to and including non-retention in accordance with the applicable collective bargaining agreement and/or CSU/University policy and/or no longer be authorized to drive on University business.
